rules.regress: each case is one subprocess `python -m designlab.stage1 eval --body B [--row-module M] --rows ROWS --conditions CONDITIONS --episodes N --workers 1 --inputs I --out <scratch>` (tools/README.md, 'Eval traces') with OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS and MKL_NUM_THREADS at 1, MUJOCO_GL=disable and STAGE1B_SPEED_RUN removed; per episode, trace_equal: the sha256 of the regenerated <out>/<body>/eval/traces/<row>/<behavior>/<condition>/<seed>.npz equals episodes[i].trace.sha256 of the committed record <run>/<body>/eval/<row>/<behavior>/<condition>.json; record_equal: the regenerated episode record equals the committed one on every key but wall_s, compared as canonical JSON after a round trip through a file (floats exactly; a NaN equals a NaN; 1 differs from 1.0); an episode matches when both hold; an eval that fails, or an episode it does not write, matches nothing
rules.clean: a run starts only in a checkout whose `git status --porcelain` is empty (the record it is writing aside) and with the arrays, the round-two model files and the committed records its cases read; the status is read again after the last case and the run is refused if anything changed; the four source hashes are read before the first case and after the last and must be equal
rules.resume: a finished case is kept in <scratch>/cases/<case id>.json and used again only if its case definition, its four source hashes, its library versions and the sha256 of regress.py are the run's and its eval exited with code 0; otherwise the case runs again from an empty directory (a case whose eval exited non-zero, or was killed, runs again); the record is written only when every case of the tier is there
rules.count: `of` counts comparisons (one per episode of every case; `matched`: the ones with both flags true); `distinct` counts the different committed episodes among them, an episode being its (run, body, row, condition, seed); the full tier holds the fast tier's episodes twice (in the fast cases and again inside its own), so `distinct` is the number of committed episodes a record proves
rules.check: a record is current when its tier is full, every episode of today's full tier is in it with both flags true (matched == of), its `distinct` is the number of different committed episodes it lists, and its four source hashes equal the ones read from today's code
